title: Validate gossip issue identifiers before building overlay paths
description:
Problem: persist_gossip_overlay (rust/src/gossip.rs:704-711) and the overlay writer (rust/src/overlay.rs:44-48, 201-218; python/src/kanbus/overlay.py:45-53) write overlay_root/issues/{identifier}.json using the identifier taken straight from a broker envelope (envelope.issue.identifier, or envelope.issue_id for tombstones) with create_dir_all and fs::write. An identifier such as ../../../.git/HEAD escapes the overlay directory. The local UDS broker accepts anonymous publishes (gossip.rs:1036-1067, no frame size limit or topic authorization) and ~/.kanbus/run is created with the default umask (gossip.rs:1620-1623). Distinct from the already-filed cross-repo topic leak (kbs-89b646).

Work, both runtimes: validate identifiers against the project issue-id grammar (letters, digits, dot, underscore, hyphen; no path separators; no '..') before building any overlay or tombstone path and reject envelopes that fail; cap UDS line length; create the run directory 0700. Add unit tests with traversal identifiers in both runtimes.

Acceptance: a gossip envelope with a traversal identifier is dropped with a logged warning and writes nothing; tests cover '../x', 'a/b', '..' and an over-long line.
